g.text: "text": "Search the web through Google's Custom Search API (PSE) to obtain live information, find documentation, or research topics when the built-in web_search is
"reason": "The description identifies the search purpose and fallback applicability."
"reason": "The introduction identifies Google's Custom Search API as the search service."
"text": "Use the skill when live information, documentation, or topic research is needed and the built-in web_search is unavailable.",
"reason": "The description expressly states the conditions for using the skill."
"text": "Create a Google Cloud project and enable the Custom Search API for it.",
"reason": "The first setup step requires a project with the API enabled."
"reason": "The second setup step explicitly requires generating an API key."
"text": "Create a Programmable Search Engine at cse.google.com and obtain its CX ID.",
"reason": "The third setup step requires an engine and the identifier belonging to that engine."
"text": "Store the API key and CX ID in a .env file in the workspace under GOOGLE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CSE_ID, respectively.",
"reason": "The environment setup step specifies the storage location and credential variable names."
"text": "Obtain runtime credentials from the GOOGLE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CSE_ID environment variables. If either is missing or empty, print \"Error: GOOGLE_API_KEY
and GOOGLE_CSE_ID must be set in environment.\" and exit with status 1.",
"reason": "The script specifies environment-based credential retrieval and the conditional missing-credential failure behavior."
"text": "Accept the search query as the first command-line argument. If it is absent, print \"Usage: python google_search.py <query> [num_results]\" and exit with
"reason": "The entry point requires a query argument and specifies the diagnostic and exit status when it is absent."
"text": "Accept an optional second command-line argument as an integer result-count parameter; default that parameter to 5 when the argument is omitted.",
"reason": "The script specifies integer conversion and the omission-dependent default."
"text": "Send an HTTP GET request to https://www.googleapis.com/customsearch/v1 with the supplied query as q, API key as key, CX ID as cx, and result-count
"reason": "The search function specifies the endpoint, method, and mapping of supplied values to request parameters."
"reason": "The entry point passes the acquired query, credentials, and result-count parameter to the search function."
"text": "Check the HTTP response for errors before decoding its JSON.",
"reason": "The search function places HTTP error checking before JSON decoding."
"text": "On a successful search, print the complete decoded API response as JSON with an indentation level of 2.",
"reason": "The function returns the decoded response without selecting a subset."
"reason": "The entry point serializes and prints the returned response with indent=2."
"text": "If an exception occurs during the search invocation or result serialization and printing, print \"Error: \" followed by the exception's string
"reason": "The exception handler specifies the diagnostic and failure exit status for operations inside the try block."
